backend/main.mo: Main actor for the bike showroom backend, defining Bike and Inquiry types with CRUD operations: addBike, getAllBikes (sorted by price), getBike, and submitInquiry, backed by Map storage.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that seeds three initial bikes (Yamaha R15, KTM Duke 390, Royal Enfield Classic 350) into the bikes map if it is empty, otherwise passes existing state through unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two implemented features—engine capacity display on bike cards/detail page and Unsplash image URL display—to their relevant frontend files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the project's React components, pages, hooks, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes covering background, foreground, card, primary, border, and sidebar color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point titled 'Bike Online Showroom' that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with four routes (catalog, bike detail, contact, contact success) all wrapped in the persistent Layout component.
frontend/src/components/BikeCard.tsx: Reusable card component that displays a bike's Unsplash photo, category badge, engine capacity, brand, name, description, specs row, and INR-formatted price with a link to the detail page.
frontend/src/components/BikeFilters.tsx: Filter panel component providing search input, category and brand dropdowns, and min/max price fields with a reset button that appears when any filter is active.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Defines the main app layout with a sticky header containing the MotoVerse logo, desktop and mobile navigation links (Catalog, Contact), and an 'Inquire Now' button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context and custom hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports React Query hooks for fetching all bikes, fetching a single bike by ID, and submitting an inquiry mutation against the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Barlow fonts, sets up Tailwind layers, defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for a dark-themed design system, and adds utility classes for gradients and card hover effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/BikeDetailPage.tsx: Detail page for a single bike that fetches bike data by ID, displays a photo carousel, specs, price, and provides navigation back to the catalog and to the contact/inquiry page.
frontend/src/pages/CatalogPage.tsx: Main catalog page featuring a hero banner, stats bar, and a filterable/searchable grid of bike cards sourced from the backend, with filters for search, category, brand, and price range.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: A contact/inquiry form page that lets users select a bike and submit their name, email, phone, and message, with validation and navigation to a success page on submission.
frontend/src/pages/ContactSuccessPage.ts: A confirmation page shown after a successful inquiry submission, displaying a thank-you message, next-step instructions, and links to browse bikes or submit another inquiry.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts (Barlow/Barlow Condensed), OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, glow box shadows, and fade-in/accordion animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for the Bike Showroom app, tracking existing features (catalog display, Unsplash images) and pending feature requests (seeding backend with three bikes and displaying their data).
